name: Living Armor
soul: The soul of someone who keeps themselves to themselves; who is always dressed to leave, and is warm to very few. Nobody is in the armor, and it stands between.
spark: The mote gets between you and the door when someone knocks. It weighs nothing, and it does not step aside.

hybrid.text: It has started standing half a step in front of you, and there is nobody in the part of it that does.

newFeatures.label: an empty helm, the field lit in its visor
plates on its shoulders with nobody under them
a banner with no device on it
a collar with nothing standing in it, and two lights above

settled.name: Squire
settled.text: A child's breastplate and a helm too big for it, walking. Nobody is in them. The light in the visor is yours, and it has put itself between you and the door.
settled.sign: A helm that slips over one side, a small dented breastplate, two mitts and two boots, and nothing joining them. Two lights in the visor look up at you.
settled.habit: It pushes its helm straight with both mitts, and stands in front of you with a pot-lid for a shield.

paths.name: Sworn Plate
paths.of: one who chose their few, once, and stands in front of them
paths.text: It learned from you that a side is taken once. It has grown into a knight's plate with nobody in it, and it carries its shield on the side you are on.
paths.sign: A knight's harness standing very straight, a gold plume on the helm and a plain gold shield. The visor is dark, with two steady lights.
paths.habit: When a stranger comes up to you it is already between, and it does not explain itself.

prongs.name: Pavise
prongs.of: one who would rather be leaned on than thanked
prongs.text: Its shield has grown taller than it is. It sets the foot of it on the ground in front of you, and what was coming stops there.
prongs.sign: A tower shield planted on its point with the helm just showing over the rim, and a gold stripe down the middle of the face.
prongs.habit: It raps the rim twice with a gauntlet before it settles, as a carter tries a wheel.

finishes.name: Wall of One
finishes.of: one who is a whole line of defence, and does not mention it
finishes.text: It carries a shield on each arm now, and closed together they are a wall with a slot to look through. It has not been gone round yet.
finishes.sign: Two tower shields shut edge to edge, crenellated along the top, gold bands across both. Two lights look out through the gap.
finishes.habit: It opens the two shields a hand's width to let you through, and shuts them behind you.

finishes.name: Open Guard
finishes.of: one who lowers the shield for exactly one person
finishes.text: It has slung the great shield on its back and lifted its visor. There is still nobody there. It holds out a hand to you all the same.
finishes.sign: The visor is up over an empty dark with two lights in it. The shield rides on its back, and a gold cape hangs under it.
finishes.habit: It keeps its visor shut for everyone else, and they take it for unfriendly.

prongs.name: Oath-plate
prongs.of: one who said it once and has been keeping it since
prongs.text: It has put the shield down and taken up a sword it holds point to the ground. It does not swing it much. It is a thing to stand behind.
prongs.sign: A long sword held point down, a gold tabard over the breastplate, and tall guards on its shoulders that stand to the helm.
prongs.habit: When you make a promise it sets the sword's point on the ground, and it does not lift it until the thing is done.

finishes.name: Vigil
finishes.of: one who stands the night through because they said they would
finishes.text: It stands where it was put with a long cloak over its plate, a small flame of your light on its helm. It was there when you slept. It is there when you wake.
finishes.sign: A cloak to the ground, the sword's point between its feet, and one small flame on the crown of the helm where a plume was.
finishes.habit: It will not sit. You have found it in the morning exactly where it stood the night before.

finishes.name: Champion
finishes.of: one who answers for someone else, in front of everyone
finishes.text: It has stepped out in front. The sword is up, the plume is as tall again as the helm, and everyone watching knows whose side it is on.
finishes.sign: The sword raised upright before its visor, a great gold plume streaming back, a short cape, and shoulder guards like wings.
finishes.habit: It walks a pace ahead of you into any room where you are to be judged.

prongs.name: Banner-harness
prongs.of: one who carries the thing the others gather round
prongs.text: A staff has grown from its backplate, and a banner on it with no device at all. It is easier to find across a field than you are.
prongs.sign: A plain gold banner on a pole from its back, standing well above the helm, and the small shield still on its arm.
prongs.habit: It turns so that the banner can be seen from wherever your friends are.

finishes.name: Standard
finishes.of: one the others look for when the line bends
finishes.text: It carries the standard in its own hand now, a pole twice its height with a long gold flag. While that stands, nobody near it runs.
finishes.sign: A great pole held upright in its right hand, a long swallow-tailed gold flag at the top, and a cape on its shoulders.
finishes.habit: It grounds the pole when it stops, and you have seen tired people straighten at the sound.

finishes.name: Cohort's Plate
finishes.of: one who wears a ribbon for each of the few they let in
finishes.text: A fan of small flags stands from its back, one for each of the people it has decided are its own. There are not many. It knows each by name.
finishes.sign: Six small gold pennons fanned behind its shoulders like a hand of cards, and ribbons tied at each elbow.
finishes.habit: It counts the pennons with one gauntlet whenever the company sets out, and again when it comes home.

paths.name: Siege-plate
paths.of: one who is a shut door, and means it
paths.text: It learned from you how to be closed. It has grown low and heavy and as wide as a doorway, and whatever wants you must come through it.
paths.sign: A barrel of banded iron on short legs, its helm sunk between slab shoulders, red bands round its chest. Its fists hang to its knees.
paths.habit: It stands in doorways. People wait for it to move, and it has never once thought they meant it.

prongs.name: Ram
prongs.of: one who goes through, since nobody opened
prongs.text: It has grown a ram's curled horns on its helm and a wedge of iron on its chest. It lowers its head, and then there is a way where there was a wall.
prongs.sign: Two heavy horns curled at the sides of the helm, a red iron wedge standing from the breastplate, and its whole weight leaning forward.
prongs.habit: It leans on a shut door for a moment before it tries the handle.

finishes.name: Breach
finishes.of: one who is the hole in the wall, walking
finishes.text: The horns have swung forward and the wedge has grown to a prow. It does not look for the gate any more. It makes one.
finishes.sign: Great horns pointing forward past its visor, spikes on its shoulders, and a prow like a ship's from throat to belt, red along the edge.
finishes.habit: It walks to a thing in a straight line, and what is in the line is moved.

finishes.name: Hundred-dent
finishes.of: one who kept every blow that was meant for someone else
finishes.text: It is dented all over and has lost a shoulder plate, and through a hole in its chest you can see there was never anyone to hurt.
finishes.sign: Broken shafts standing from its back, one shoulder bare, and a torn hole in the breastplate with your light showing in the empty inside.
finishes.habit: It turns the dented side toward whatever is coming, as if that side were used to it.

prongs.name: Mantlet
prongs.of: one who brings the wall along
prongs.text: Half a door has grown on each of its forearms, oak and iron. When it brings its arms together there is a door in the road, and it is shut.
prongs.sign: Two tall leaves of an oak door, one on each arm, banded with iron and painted red. The helm looks over the top of them.
prongs.habit: It shuts its arms when you sleep in the open, and sits facing outward until it is light.

finishes.name: Gatehouse
finishes.of: one who decides who comes in, and is rarely asked twice
finishes.text: It has grown turrets on its shoulders and battlements round its helm. It is a gate with a keep behind it, and it looks at everyone who passes under.
finishes.sign: A round turret on each shoulder, a ring of battlements on the helm, a small red flag on one turret, and the two door-leaves below.
finishes.habit: It lets your friends pass without looking, and looks at everyone else for a long time.

finishes.name: Lock and Bar
finishes.of: one who was closed long ago and kept the key themselves
finishes.text: The two leaves have closed into one door across its whole front, barred, with your light in the keyhole. It has the key. It has never said where.
finishes.sign: One great barred door from its helm to its knees, a keyhole in the middle with light in it, and a ring of keys at its hip.
finishes.habit: The keys chime when it walks. It has never used one where you could see.

prongs.name: Furnace-plate
prongs.of: one who keeps what they feel banked behind iron
prongs.text: There is a fire in the empty of it now, behind a grate in its belly. That is where it keeps what it will not say, and it is warm to stand near.
prongs.sign: A barred grate in its belly with your light behind the bars, and a stub of chimney standing from its back.
prongs.habit: The grate glows a little brighter when you come back from somewhere. It turns that side away.

finishes.name: Kiln
finishes.of: one who is warm at last, to whoever stands close enough
finishes.text: It has opened the grate. It is a walking kiln now, two chimneys and a wide door of light, and the few it lets near are never cold.
finishes.sign: Two chimneys with smoke standing from them, a wide open furnace door in its belly, and red tiles laid over its shoulders.
finishes.habit: It stands with its back to the wind and its open side to you.

finishes.name: Banked
finishes.of: one who has gone cold on the outside on purpose
finishes.text: It has shut the furnace door and drawn a cloak of ash over the iron. Only a line of light round the door says the fire was never let out.
finishes.sign: A shut iron door on its belly with a thread of light round its edge, a grey-red cloak, and a hood drawn over the helm.
finishes.habit: It lets you warm your hands at the seam of the door. It does not open it.

paths.name: Wayfarer's Harness
paths.of: one who is always dressed to leave
paths.text: It learned from you to keep its things by the door. It has grown tall and light, laced plates under a travelling cape, and it walks the edge of wherever you are.
paths.sign: A wide-brimmed iron hat over an empty dark, a blue-green cape and scarf, rows of small laced plates, and a staff.
paths.habit: It stands nearest the way out of any room, and it has always already seen where that is.

prongs.name: Lantern-watch
prongs.of: one who walks the dark round so the others need not
prongs.text: It has hung a lamp of your light on its staff, and it walks the bounds of the camp with it while everyone else is asleep.
prongs.sign: A lantern swinging from a crook at the top of its staff, and the cape grown to a cloak that reaches its heels.
prongs.habit: It walks round the place you sleep three times before it stands still.

finishes.name: Last Lamp
finishes.of: one who is the light left on for whoever is still out
finishes.text: It has no helm now. Where its head was there is a lantern, lit, and it stands at the gate until the last of you is in.
finishes.sign: A six-sided lantern on its shoulders in place of a helm, alight, a long cloak, and the staff held like a gatepost.
finishes.habit: It will not come in until it has counted everyone. It counts the dead as well.

finishes.name: Dark Lantern
finishes.of: one who sees without being seen to look
finishes.text: It has shuttered the lamp and closed its helm to one slit. It stands wrapped in its cloak at the edge of the light and misses nothing.
finishes.sign: A cloak wrapped all round it like a bell, a smooth closed helm with a single light in the slit, and a shuttered lamp held low.
finishes.habit: It opens one shutter the width of a finger, toward the thing you ought to have noticed.

prongs.name: Outrider
prongs.of: one who goes ahead to see, and comes back to say
prongs.text: It has taken a spear with a pennon and a helm with a tail, and it is out ahead of you before you have decided which way to go.
prongs.sign: A long spear with a blue-green pennon, a swept helm with a fin along the crown, and long legs under a short flying cape.
prongs.habit: It comes back from ahead and stands where the bad footing is, so you will walk round it.

finishes.name: Long Patrol
finishes.of: one whose round is longer every year and still walked
finishes.text: Its skirts and shoulders have grown broad with laced plates, and it carries a bedroll and a tall glaive. Its round takes a season. It has not missed one.
finishes.sign: A tall glaive with a long pennon, a high fin on the helm, wide laced shoulder-plates and skirts, and a bedroll across its back.
finishes.habit: It scratches a mark on the gatepost each time it comes home, and there are a great many.

finishes.name: Pathfinder
finishes.of: one who travels light and is hard to follow
finishes.text: It has left off every plate it could spare. What is left is a hat, a breast of lacing, a long scarf, and a way of being gone when looked for.
finishes.sign: No shoulder plates and no skirts: a brimmed hat, a narrow laced breast, a scarf twice its own length flying behind, and a short staff.
finishes.habit: It walks on the stones and the roots. You have never found a print of it.

prongs.name: Hermit-plate
prongs.of: one who keeps their own company and keeps it well
prongs.text: It has pulled a hood over its helm and its cloak shut in front. It is not unfriendly. It has all the company it wants, and you are most of it.
prongs.sign: A deep hood over the helm with two lights far back in it, the cloak closed to its shins, and a staff with a crook.
prongs.habit: It sits a little apart from any fire, facing the dark, and listens to the talk.

finishes.name: Waystone
finishes.of: one who has stood in one place so long the road bends round them
finishes.text: It stood still to think, and moss has come up its cloak and stones have been left on its hat by people passing. It is a mark on the map now.
finishes.sign: A pile of flat stones on the brim of its hat, moss up the hem of a cloak that reaches the ground, and no staff. It stands like a stone.
finishes.habit: Travellers leave a pebble on it for luck. It lets them, and keeps count.

finishes.name: Empty Road
finishes.of: one who left even the helm behind and is still on their feet
finishes.text: It has put down its helm somewhere and not gone back. Two lights hang over the empty collar where a face would be, and they still look at you first.
finishes.sign: No helm at all: an empty iron collar with two small lights floating above it, a torn cloak blowing sideways, and a long staff.
finishes.habit: It still tips its head to you, though there is no head. You have learned to tell.
